CREATE VIEW gold.calander
AS
(

SELECT *
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'https://saawstoragedatalake.dfs.core.windows.net/silver/AdventureWorks_Customers/',
    FORMAT='PARQUET'
) as AdventureWorks_Customers

)

CREATE gold.calander
AS
(

SELECT *
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'https://saawstoragedatalake.dfs.core.windows.net/silver/AdventureWorks_Calendar/',
    FORMAT='PARQUET'
) as calander
)

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE gold.extsales
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'extsales',
    DATA_SOURCE = source_gold,
    FILE_FORMAT = format_parquet
)
AS
SELECT *
FROM gold.sales;
